title: SLATE — free OSS prompt generator for image/video/music models
gap: Only a shrinking one: a Chinese-model version (即梦/可灵/海螺) doesn't exist — but the underlying pain is being absorbed by the models themselves.

zh.gap: 只剩一条在收窄的缝：中文模型侧（即梦/可灵/海螺）还没有对应版本——但这个痛本身正在被模型吸收。
zh.pain: 创作者知道自己想看到什么，却不知道模型想听哪句咒语。
zh.kill: 提示词优化是每个生成平台的内置功能，且模型每迭代一代就更不需要它。给正在合拢的缝贴创可贴——是功能，不是公司。
zh.move: 若真要碰：做中文模型适配版，在即梦/可灵社区当工作流卖——但诚实的判断是窗口在关。

pain: A creator who knows what they want to see, but not the incantation the model wants to hear.
kill: Prompt optimisation is a feature every generation platform ships natively, and each model generation needs it less. A band-aid on a closing gap — a feature, not a company.
move: If touched at all: the Chinese-model adaptation, sold as a workflow inside 即梦/可灵 communities — but the honest read is the window is closing.
